---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for SAIL
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Summary

A brief, clear description of the feature you're requesting.

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature would solve. What limitation or gap does it address?

Example: "I'm frustrated when [...]" or "Currently there's no way to [...]"

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Provide specific examples of how this feature would be used:

1. User scenario 1...
2. User scenario 2...

## Privacy Considerations

SAIL is a privacy-first application. Please consider:

- [ ] This feature can work entirely locally (no cloud dependencies)
- [ ] This feature does not require sending data externally
- [ ] This feature respects user data sovereignty

If any of the above are unchecked, please explain why and propose mitigations.

## Implementation Ideas

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, share them here (optional).

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have considered the privacy implications of this feature
- [ ] This feature aligns with SAIL's core principles (local, private, sovereign)
